summary: Validate Wellman source without floating build dependencies

delivery.outcome: Avoid floating pip build dependencies by validating adopted metadata directly from exact dependency-free Wellman source.
nonGoals: No changes to application code or adopted metadata
No new required-check policy or bypass of independent publication

architecture.decision: Use a pinned checkout action for Wellman revision 58d7ae1ba768ead256e0e9a05fd641a0d8faec28, verify its Git SHA, and import its dependency-free source only in the metadata validation step.
architecture.rollback: Revert this workflow; keep existing governance and product checks.

validation.evidence: The same pinned runtime and checker succeed locally and in the hosted metadata job.
Managed gate validates the infrastructure scope.
